name: GPT-1
description:
Here is how to read the GPT-1 config.json. The architecture class is OpenAIGPTLMHeadModel, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 768: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 40,478 × 768: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_attention_heads is 12, so each head sees 64 dimensions (768 / 12). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 768 / 12 = 64. 64 is a multiple of 32 (NVIDIA warp-friendly), and a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly), and a power of two (Triton / FlashAttention-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_hidden_layers is 12: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

vocab_size is 40,478. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/openai-community/openai-gpt/blob/main/config.json.
